verdict.rationale: React ships its own build-time React Compiler. It automatically optimizes components and removes manual useMemo, useCallback and React.memo, can be adopted incrementally, and has debugging docs. React's runtime also updates the screen to match new data, so developers never write diffing code themselves. However, the evidence frames the compiler as memoization on top of React's runtime update mechanism, not as compiling components into surgical DOM updates. missing for 10: evidence that compiled output performs fine-grained/surgical DOM updates, independent or hands-on corroboration of the compiler's performance impact.
